intro.text: A name for a Rosharan city so old that its origins can be traced back to the Dawnsingers.

description.text: Talking about the Dawncities had lately become fashionable among Alethi lighteyes, and Highprince Hatham's wife studied them. Au-nak held that Sesemalex Dar was one, because of the intricate stone patterns the city is built among. Dalinar saw no trace of any Dawncity in his visions.
